plan.title: Treatment-specific time-course DE beyond shared trend
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — which genes show a treatment-specific change over the four time points, beyond the shared time trend — is precisely the DESeq2 time-course likelihood-ratio-test (LRT) scenario: fit the full model ~condition+time+condition:time against the reduced model ~condition+time, so the interaction term (dropped from the reduced model) isolates genes whose time trajectory differs by condition, independent of any trend shared by both conditions. This design has 2 conditions x 4 time points x 3 replicates (12000 genes x 24 samples in counts.csv/metadata.csv), which per the Inflexa knowledge service means the interaction test itself is grounded (R-0014) but underpowered at n=3/cell (R-0063, R-0017) — the report must state this explicitly and never loosen alpha to compensate. The pipeline: (1) sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) to catch batch/outlier structure before any model is fit; (2) minimal count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >= smallest group of 3) leaving independent filtering to do the rest; (3) DESeq2 model with design ~condition+time+condition:time, explicit reference levels for both condition and time, counts treated as gene-level salmon counts (tximport/lengthScaledTPM is the sourced-default import path, but as no transcript-level quantification files are provided here — only a gene-level count matrix — this step is skipped and flagged); (4) LRT of full vs reduced design to get one interaction p-value per gene, BH-adjusted at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering; (5) apeglm-shrunken per-timepoint interaction coefficients and simple condition effects at each timepoint, reported alongside the LRT p-value, for interpretability and ranking, not for the significance call itself; (6) cluster the significant genes' log2FC trajectories across timepoints (hierarchical clustering on the shrunken per-timepoint fold changes) and plot mean trajectories per cluster, since a single fold change cannot describe a time x condition interaction gene (R-0091); (7) enrichment restricted to over-representation analysis (the knowledge-service check rejects ranked GSEA here because a single scalar rank statistic cannot represent a multi-timepoint interaction — the correct enrichment input is the discrete list of interaction-significant genes against the tested-gene universe), run against the human MSigDB Hallmark set first and Reactome pathways second, both staged in the reference store; (8) a consolidated report with the reproducibility record, MA/dispersion diagnostics, the p-value histogram, the interaction table (gene, LRT stat, padj, per-timepoint shrunken log2FC, cluster assignment), and explicit power-limitation and count-outlier-NA caveats.
